messages:
asha: Heads-up: UX review for model compare table. Main questions: where pinned versions live, keyboard flow for pin/unpin, and how badges behave when theme toggles. Screenshot: https://redwood-assets/internal/compare-table-pin.png

miguel: Quick read 440. If we make pinned column sticky it can push other important columns out of view at small widths. Mobile is the real constraint.

zoe: For desktop I like sticky left for discoverability. On mobile we could collapse pinned into a floating pill in the header that toggles focus to the pinned row.

priya: Copy thought: current action says "Pin" and state says "Pinned". Can we use "Pin version" and state "Pinned (v2.3)"? Also aria-label for action should be "Pin version v2.3" so screen readers understand target.

tom: Implementation ops: sticky requires z-index and repaint on scroll which may be janky with virtualization. If we go sticky, we should avoid per-row shadows. Alternative: add a compact 'flag' column (8px) with a visible badge when pinned, no sticky for now.

asha: Accessibility: when a pin state changes we should announce via aria-live polite: "Version v2.3 pinned" so keyboard/screen reader users get feedback. Also focus should remain on the pin button after toggling.

miguel: Agree on aria-live. Also recommend toggle uses role=button with aria-pressed true/false rather than a generic link.

zoe: Visual affordance: small star icon is subtle. Suggest star + label collapse: show icon only in dense mode, show "Pinned" pill in expanded mode. For high contrast we should avoid thin strokes.

designbot: automated-a11y-check: contrast failure detected for pill-bg #f3f4f6 on text #111827 -> ratio 2.9:1. Suggest pill-bg #e5e7eb or text #0f172a for AA compliance at 12px.

priya: Two microcopy options: 1) action: "Pin version" / undo: "Unpin version"; state: "Pinned (v2.3)". 2) shorter: action: "Pin" / state: "Pinned" with aria-labels providing detail. Leaning to option 1 for clarity.

tom: Note on keyboard: we'll need tabindex=0 on the pin control and Space/Enter handlers. Also provide a visible focus ring; avoid color-only outlines.

miguel: For performance badges (latency/cost/throughput), proposal: initials monogram + 3px rounded bg. Use text content like "L 12ms" rather than colored-only chips so color-blind users can parse.

zoe: Could we allow column-level toggle to 'pin to left' so user-controlled sticky? That might be heavy but great power-user feature. Keep for later.

asha: Decision proposal: immediate changes = (A) implement compact flag column (non-sticky) with clear "Pinned" pill for expanded rows, (B) pin control uses role=button/aria-pressed + aria-live announcement, (C) update badges to include initials or short label + color, (D) fix contrast as designbot suggested. Longer-term: consider sticky or user pinning control.

priya: I'll finalize copy snippets and add aria examples: e.g., aria-label="Pin version v2.3" aria-pressed="false" and aria-live text template "Version v2.3 pinned".

miguel: I'll prototype the flag column CSS and keyboard handlers. Quick snippet to demo focus ring: ```css
.pin-btn:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }
```

zoe: I'll update mocks for dense/expanded states and add states for high-contrast theme.

asha: I'll file a small ticket and assign: PLAT-512 pin-flag-ux. Target: small PR next week. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

designbot: task-created: PLAT-512 pin-flag-ux.
